paper_metadata.title: Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of Vacuum Brazed Nb SS/Nb5Si3 Composite Joints Using Ni-Based Filler Alloys

evidence.quote: Nb SS/Nb5Si3 in situ composite material is one of the potential high-temperature structural material candidates
Vacuum brazing of Nb SS/Nb5Si3 composite was performed with BNi2 and BNi5 ﬁller alloys at 1293-1423 K for 1800 seconds.

the content of elements Ni and Cr in the dark band (microzone ‘‘7’’) is 42.2 and 48.3 at. pct, respectively. It is known that the element B is diﬃcult to be detected, and microzone ‘‘7’’ might be boride mixture of Ni 3B and CrB.

The Nb SS/Nb5Si3 joints brazed with BNi2 ﬁller at 1293 K/1800 s presented an average shear strength of 180 MPa.
The Nb SS/Nb5Si3 joints brazed with BNi2 ﬁller at 1423 K for 1800 seconds exhibited an average shear strength of 253 MPa (Figure 7).
The joints brazed with BNi5 ﬁller at 1423 K for 1800 seconds presented an average shear strength of 274 MPa (Figure 7).
In the case of BNi2 ﬁllers (Figure 11(a)), the maximum hardness of 1240 HV appears within the central part of the brazing seam (mircozone ‘‘1’’).
Microzone ‘‘2’’ in Figure 4(b), mainly composed of Nb SS+borides, exhibits signiﬁcantly lower micro-hardness value of about 490 HV.
In microzone ‘‘3’’, the presence of the Cr 2Nb makes the micro-hardness at the level of about 1150 HV.
The maximum micro-hardness (970 HV) occurs in the lamellar structure (microzone ‘‘4’’ in Figure 8(b)) mainly consisting of Ni 3Si + Nb 3Si + CrB.
the matrix phases in the central area of the brazed seam, with the mixture of (Ni,Cr) 3Si + (Nb,Ti) 3Si and borides, present a lower micro-hardness of about 700 HV.

In general, the formation of brittle intermetallics in the brazing seam could decrease the joint strength. Evidently, due to the high-micro-hardness, the mixture of Ni 3Si and Nb 3Si phases would be detrimental to the joint strength.
During the brazing process, Nb atoms diﬀused into the brazing seam strongly and caused the formation of Cr 2Nb.

mechanisms.name: dissolution of Ni into (Nb,Ti) solid solution

evidence.quote: element Ni could diﬀuse into the Nb-Si substrate material and could be dissolved into the (Nb,Ti) SS with about 4-5 at. pct concentration

Hence, Nb-Si compound should be more easily to form in the brazing seam during the interfacial reaction than Cr-Nb compound. Nb atoms from the substrates had reacted with Si before it could diﬀuse to the center of the brazing seam. Thus Cr 2Nb compound was absent in the BNi5 brazed joint.
